youtube.title: Promoted to AI Babysitter in 2026? 🤖 Find Out Now!
youtube.description:
You've been promoted from coder to AI babysitter in 2026! Curious about what that actually means? This video dives into how developers are evolving their workflows with AI tools. Spoiler: you're not just writing code – you're building a library of skills.

Imagine a world where you rarely look at AI-generated code and instead read plans and ask the right questions to ship products effortlessly. One developer even managed to create three side projects entirely from his phone – all by understanding and documenting AI-generated plans.

But it doesn't stop there. Every error turns into reusable knowledge, streamlining your future projects. Coding isn't just about writing anymore; it's about feeding skills to your local models and speeding up processes.

linkedin.text:
Did you know you've been promoted from coder to AI babysitter?

In 2026, developers are using AI tools not just to write code but to revolutionize their entire workflow. Instead of debugging line by line, you're now documenting errors into reusable skills. Imagine saving hours by transforming every mistake into a lesson that speeds up your next project.

One developer managed to build three side projects just from his phone. How? By trusting AI to generate plans and asking the right questions.

Traditional coding took hours to debug, but AI babysitting? Just thirty minutes to document the fix forever.

I made a short video about this fascinating shift. If you're curious about how AI can change your coding game, check it out. 

What do you think—are we ready to babysit our AIs?
